title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named stops along NW Monroe Avenue, the 14th–26th Street corridor that connects Oregon State University with Corvallis businesses.

cards.title: Mediterranean at Crystal's Cuisine & Cafe
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · corner of NW 14th Street
cards.notes: Walk to the NW 14th Street corner and use the café's menu to choose among shawerma, gyros, falafel, and baba ghanouj.
cards.short_summary: A named Mediterranean café at the east end of the Monroe corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Crystal's Cuisine & Cafe identifies its location as the corner of SW Monroe Avenue and NW 14th Street and lists Mediterranean menu items including shawerma, gyros, and falafel.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service; check the business directly for current availability.

cards.title: Made-to-Order Crepes at The Naked Crepe
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · Cobblestone Square at NW 14th Street
cards.notes: Stop at the Cobblestone Square storefront when you want a sweet or savory crepe made to order along Monroe Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A crepe storefront at the 14th-and-Monroe end of the corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Travel Oregon lists The Naked Crepe at 1425 NW Monroe Ave and describes sweet and savory crepes made to order from its 14th-and-Monroe storefront.
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; confirm current service details with the business.

cards.title: Hawaiian Plates at Local Boyz
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · Cobblestone Square
cards.notes: Use the 1425 NW Monroe Avenue stop for a meal centered on the café's traditional Hawaiian dishes, including sweet shoyu chicken.
cards.short_summary: A named Hawaiian-food stop in Cobblestone Square.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State University's College of Science lists Local Boyz Hawaiian Cafe at 1425 NW Monroe Avenue and notes traditional Hawaiian dishes such as sweet shoyu chicken.
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; verify current menu and service before going.

cards.title: Thai Chili at Cobblestone Square
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · 1425 NW Monroe Avenue
cards.notes: Choose this Cobblestone Square stop for Thai food, and plan to bring cash because OSU's dining guide identifies it as cash only.
cards.short_summary: A Thai-food destination with a practical payment note.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State University's College of Science lists Thai Chili at 1425 NW Monroe Avenue and identifies the restaurant as cash only.
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; bring cash and verify current service details.

cards.title: Coffee and Wi-Fi at Interzone
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · 1563 NW Monroe Avenue
cards.notes: Make the short walk west along Monroe for coffee, then use the vegetarian or vegan menu and the shop's listed free Wi-Fi.
cards.short_summary: A coffee-shop stop with vegetarian and vegan food options.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State University's College of Science lists Interzone Coffee Shop at 1563 NW Monroe Avenue with organic coffee, a vegetarian/vegan menu, and free Wi-Fi.
cards.access_notes: Purchases are required for menu items; ask staff about Wi-Fi access and current seating policies.

cards.title: Thai and Pho at Lemongrass
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · 1603 NW Monroe Avenue
cards.notes: Use this 1603 NW Monroe Avenue destination when you want Thai cuisine or pho, as identified in Oregon State's local dining guide.
cards.short_summary: A named noodle-house stop just west of the 14th Street cluster.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State University's College of Science lists Lemongrass Noodle House at 1603 NW Monroe Avenue and identifies its cuisine as Thai and pho.
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; confirm current menu and service before visiting.

cards.title: Rice Bowls at Café Yumm!
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · 2001 NW Monroe Avenue
cards.notes: Head to the 2001 NW Monroe Avenue location for Asian-inspired rice bowls, wraps, and salads with vegetarian-friendly options.
cards.short_summary: A Monroe Avenue stop for vegetarian-friendly bowls, wraps, and salads.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State University's College of Science lists Café Yumm! at 2001 NW Monroe Avenue and describes vegetarian-friendly Asian-inspired rice bowls, wraps, and salads.
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; verify current menu and service details with the restaurant.

cards.title: Sandwiches at Jersey Mike's
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · 2051 NW Monroe Avenue
cards.notes: Use the 2051 NW Monroe Avenue storefront for a quick sandwich stop while moving along the corridor beside campus.
cards.short_summary: A named sandwich-shop destination in the middle of the Monroe corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Union's Corvallis location page lists Jersey Mike's Subs at 2051 NW Monroe Ave.
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; check the restaurant directly for current menu and service.

cards.title: Pizza at American Dream
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · 2525 NW Monroe Avenue
cards.notes: Continue toward the 26th Street end of Monroe for the campus American Dream Pizza location listed in OSU's nearby-restaurants guide.
cards.short_summary: A named pizza stop near the west end of the corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State University's College of Science lists American Dream Pizza at 2525 NW Monroe Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; confirm current service and menu details directly.

cards.title: Coffee and Tea at Allan's
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · corner of NW 26th Street
cards.notes: Finish at the 26th-and-Monroe corner for a coffee or tea stop directly across from Oregon State University.
cards.short_summary: A long-running café at the west endpoint of the Monroe corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Allan's Coffee & Tea states that its Corvallis café is at 2541 NW Monroe Street, on the corner of Monroe and 26th Street across from Oregon State University.
cards.source_title: Corvallis Campus Remodel — Allan's Coffee & Tea
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks require a purchase; check the café directly for current service details.
